docs.title: Pelmet & Rowe - who we are
docs.text:
Pelmet & Rowe - who we are

A seven-person shop that measures things for people who have been guessing.

Ozric Tarrandale is head of data at Pelmet & Rowe and looks after the survey pipeline. He will tell you, at length, that a confidence interval is not a decoration.

We do not publish client names. We do publish our methodology, which is unusual enough that people write to ask whether it is a mistake.

docs.title: Measurement Weekly - survey pipelines that hold
docs.text:
Measurement Weekly - survey pipelines that hold

"The pipeline is the study," said Ozric Tarrandale, head of data at Pelmet & Rowe, when asked why his team spends more time on ingestion than on modelling.

The piece goes on to describe three failure modes, of which the third -- a silently dropped stratum -- is the one that ends careers.
